evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: 'Owned' vs 'rented' intelligence set as opposed categories through parallel construction.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Perspective spoken of AS an asset — a thing kept — not mere vividness; the clause performs the metaphor directly.

mints.name: PerspectiveAsRetainedAsset
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the expression casting a cognitive or epistemic resource as a retained asset against a commoditized substrate?
